**Finding: COMPLIANT (preferred position) — MINCOMMIT**

- **No commitment exists.** Section 3.1 is a pure revenue share — 30% of Net Sales above an $11,000/month threshold — so the Company pays only on actual sales activity. There is no minimum fee, minimum order volume, shortfall or take-or-pay mechanic anywhere in the document (targeted searches for "minimum", "shortfall", "take or pay", "volume commitment" and ordered-quantity language all returned nothing).
- **Preferred elements both satisfied:** no minimum purchase/volume commitment; payment tied exclusively to usage (Net Sales actually generated). No redline proposed.
- **Boundary calls noted, not flagged here:** the Section 4.2 Termination Payment (trailing Net Sales less $800,000, halved) is an exit fee for the termination-payment rule, and the Section 6.1 restriction on similar Internet projects is an exclusivity restriction — neither is a purchase or volume commitment, so both are left to their own rules rather than double-flagged.
